input.name: deltaai
input.toml:
# Arboria cluster profiles. Copy to ~/.config/arboria/clusters.toml
# (or $ARBORIA_CONFIG_DIR/clusters.toml). One table per machine.
# `arb machine init <name>` measures these on the cluster and prints (or --write's) the table.
# <placeholders> are refused until filled in. Numbers below were measured on DeltaAI (2026-11).

[deltaai]
kind = "slurm"            # "fake" is allowed too, for tests and dry runs
host = "deltaai"          # ~/.ssh/config alias with ControlMaster
arch = "aarch64"
account = "<from `accounts`>"
gpus_per_node = 4
cpus_per_gpu = 72         # 288 cores / 4 GPUs: 72 CPUs bill as one GPU
mem_per_gpu_gb = 110.898  # DefMemPerGPU 113560 MB; more bills as more GPUs
default_partition = "ghx4"
max_segments = 4
balance_cmd = "accounts"
billing_per_su = 1000     # sacct billing=1000 for an hour = 1 SU (0: estimate locally)
prelude = []              # shell lines, e.g. module loads
env_activate = []         # shell lines that activate the env (container or uv/pixi venv)
[deltaai.partitions.ghx4]
max_walltime = "48h"
charge = 1.0
[deltaai.partitions."ghx4-interactive"]
max_walltime = "2h"
charge = 2.0              # billing weights are 2x here (already in sacct billing)
[deltaai.paths]
runs = "/projects/<proj>/$USER/arboria/runs"
data = "/work/nvme/<proj>/$USER/data"
cache = "/projects/<proj>/$USER/cache"
ckpt = "/work/hdd/<proj>/$USER/ckpt"
out  = "/projects/<proj>/$USER/arboria/out"

default_partition = "ghx4"
max_segments = 4
balance_cmd = "accounts"
billing_per_su = 1000
prelude = ["a\nb"]
env_activate = []
[deltaai.partitions.ghx4]
max_walltime = "48h"
charge = 1.0
[deltaai.partitions."ghx4-interactive"]
max_walltime = "2h"
charge = 2.0
[deltaai.paths]
runs = "/projects/bjki/$USER/arboria/runs"
data = "/work/nvme/bjki/$USER/data"
cache = "/projects/bjki/$USER/arboria/cache"
ckpt = "/work/hdd/bjki/$USER/arboria/ckpt"
out = "/projects/bjki/$USER/arboria/out"

cases.error: ArbError: clusters.toml: [bad name]: invalid machine name

input.name: bad name
input.toml:
['bad name']
kind = "slurm"

cases.error: ArbError: clusters.toml: [deltaai] must be a table

input.name: deltaai
input.toml: deltaai = "x"

name: clusters_parse_profile
notes: input.toml is clusters.toml text; the case parses it (tomllib) and validates table input.name with parse_profile(name, table, source). Output is the normalized Profile: partitions keyed by name plus partition_order (TOML order), mem_per_gpu_gb/billing_per_su/charge as floats, account stripped, account_set = non-empty and no '<' / '>'. Error messages name keys in TOML order where it matters (first bad partition wins).
